title: “The world and history will judge the silence of nations in the face of these crimes”
author: Jay Watts
content:
Statement released by the Embassy of the Islamic Republic of Iran in Mexico on
Tuesday, April 7th, 2026.

Statement by Mr. Abolfazl Pasandideh, Ambassador of the Islamic Republic of
Iran to the United Mexican States

In recent days, everyone has heard the threats shouted by Donald Trump
regarding an attack on Iran that would "send it back to the Stone Age." Those
who call on Iran to reach a "deal" through the language of violence have yet
to grasp the reality of this land. Iran is not a country that surrenders to
threats; Iran is a country of resistance, rationality, and honor.

The Iranian people, faced with war and aggression, not only defend themselves
but continue to live and rebuild the country. Iran is not simply a collection
of roads, bridges, and buildings. Iran is home to all of us. Iran is a living
civilization, a nation that has repeatedly risen from the flames, destruction,
and invasions, rebuilding itself each time with greater conviction and resolve

When the President of the United States speaks of "returning Iran to the Stone
Age," this is not simply political rhetoric; it is the revelation of a
worldview. It is, in essence, a war crime project that not even Nazi Germany
admitted to with such a level of cynicism. Sadly, most countries, just as they
remained silent in the face of the genocide of the Palestinian people in Gaza,
remain silent in the face of Trump's threat to destroy Iran's millennia-old
civilization. This inaction will have terrifying consequences for the future
of humanity and will gradually contribute to the creation of a new Nazi regime
in the 21st century.

By adopting this approach and this new language based on threats and insults,
Trump has placed himself among the most terrifying leaders of a "Stone
Age"—leaders who believe that everything not under their control, from
knowledge and universities to industry, from bridges and steel mills to cancer
drugs and vaccine-producing institutes, must be set for destruction

A reading of the US and Israeli strategy reveals that the objectives of the
war to resolve the Iranian question, as one of the most important bulwarks of
the "new geometry of global power," were designed on three levels: the
ultimate goal, to dominate Iran; the intermediate goal, to divide Iran; and
the minimum goal, to destroy the infrastructure to weaken the country in the
face of future attacks.

However, reality shows that, due to the firm defense of the military forces
and the awareness of the people, since the first two objectives have not been
achieved under the current conditions, the logic of the war has descended to
"pure destruction"; that is, to make Iran uninhabitable—like Gaza—in the hope
of devouring it

However, Iran will not return to the Stone Age. The history of this land is
the story of overcoming every crisis and continually rising again. What has
sustained Iran is not only its military capability, but its profound
civilizational capacity and national consciousness. A reality as great as Iran
cannot be erased from history by bombing. Iran will remain a land that creates
civilization and, God willing, will shine like the sun

The United States and the Israeli regime have assassinated our leaders, killed
school-age children, attacked hospitals, universities, energy facilities, and
desalination plants, targeted the Pasteur Institute of vaccines and major
bridges and railway lines, and openly threaten to bomb our electrical
infrastructure and "send Iran back to the Stone Age."

Are there any crimes left they haven't yet committed?

The world and history will judge the silence of nations in the face of these
crimes, especially the silence of Western countries that claim to defend
democracy and human rights. All free governments and peoples are called upon
to stop this madness and barbarism, as it will negatively affect life around
the world. The degradation represented by the application of the law of the
jungle by Trump and Netanyahu will signify a setback for all human
civilization.

Mexico City, April 7, 2026
